content.user_title: Improve Visibility in AI Search Results
content.value_statement: Brands struggle to earn citations and recommendations in AI-generated answers. This skill turns visibility findings into practical content, crawlability, and authority improvements.
actual_capabilities: Guides audits of priority queries across Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and Copilot.
Reviews content extractability through definitions, FAQs, tables, headings, and self-contained answer passages.
Checks robots.txt guidance for major AI crawlers and explains training and citation tradeoffs.
Recommends authority signals such as sourced statistics, expert attribution, freshness, and author credentials.
Plans machine-readable resources including llms.txt, pricing files, and optional Open Knowledge Format bundles.
Separates citations, mentions, recommendations, and recommendation framing for clearer measurement.
limitations: The skill cannot guarantee citations, rankings, mentions, or recommendations.
It does not replace a technical SEO audit or structured data implementation.
Platform behavior, crawler policies, and experimental formats can change after the guidance was written.
Accurate audits require current query results, site details, and reliable source data.

use_cases.title: Audit a SaaS Brand
use_cases.description: Measure citation gaps, compare competitors, and prioritize product pages, guides, reviews, and machine-readable resources.

use_cases.title: Improve Editorial Content
use_cases.description: Restructure articles with direct answers, sourced evidence, comparison tables, clear headings, and freshness signals.

use_cases.title: Prepare an Agent-Readable Store
use_cases.description: Improve product feeds, public pricing, crawler access, business profiles, and structured content for AI-assisted discovery.

prompt_templates.title: Check One Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this page for AI search visibility: [page content or URL details]. Identify five practical improvements and explain their priority.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a single page

prompt_templates.title: Build a Query Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an AI visibility audit for [brand] across these queries: [queries]. Compare citations, mentions, recommendations, competitors, and source patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Rewrite for Extractability
prompt_templates.prompt: Restructure this article for human clarity and AI extractability: [content]. Add direct answers, evidence opportunities, useful headings, FAQs, and comparison tables.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Cross-Platform Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Develop a ninety-day AI search strategy for [brand]. Use current visibility, audience platforms, competitors, technical access, authority gaps, and measurement constraints.

output_examples.input: Audit a product page that hides pricing and lacks citations.
output: Priority one: publish clear pricing and plan limits on an indexable page.
Priority two: add sourced performance claims and visible update dates.
Priority three: answer common buyer questions with concise, self-contained sections.

output_examples.input: Explain why a cited brand is not being recommended.
output_examples.output: The content is useful enough to cite, but independent reviews and community discussions do not yet support shortlist placement. Invest in credible third-party proof.

output_examples.input: Create a monthly AI visibility scorecard.
output: Track citation rate, mention rate, recommendation rate, and mention framing.
Record cited pages and competing sources for each priority query.
Compare branded search changes with visible AI referral traffic.

best_practices: Use current results from the platforms your audience actually uses.
Support important claims with named sources, dates, and transparent methodology.
Measure citations and recommendations separately because they reflect different signals.
anti_patterns: Do not mass-produce thin content designed only to manipulate AI answers.
Do not fabricate reviews, citations, expert quotes, statistics, or community mentions.
Do not treat experimental files as confirmed ranking factors without evidence.

faq.question: What is AI SEO?
faq.answer: AI SEO improves how search assistants discover, understand, cite, mention, and recommend content.

faq.question: Does this skill guarantee AI citations?
faq.answer: No. It identifies practical improvements, but each platform controls retrieval, citation, and recommendation decisions.

faq.question: Does this replace traditional SEO?
faq.answer: No. Technical accessibility, useful content, authority, and standard search performance remain the foundation.

faq.question: Can it create an llms.txt plan?
faq.answer: Yes. It can recommend content and links for llms.txt, but it cannot guarantee that any platform will use the file.

faq.question: What information improves the audit?
faq.answer: Provide priority queries, target audiences, current pages, competitor names, platform results, crawler rules, and available analytics.

faq.question: How should results be measured?
faq.answer: Track retrieval signals, citations, mentions, recommendations, mention framing, cited pages, competitors, branded search, and referral traffic.
